title: Scandinavian UFOs come down only in water

tellings.quote:
and it is important it is not a single
object has crashed on land in Sweden or
Norway

plain: A Swedish UFO researcher named Clas Svahn says on Jesse Michels' podcast that, since 1946, the unexplained objects reported coming down in Sweden and Norway have all come down in water. He stresses that not a single one has crashed on land in either country. He sees this as an important pattern, since it would suggest the objects choose, or need, water.
